asr.full_text: Goldman Sachs is obviously very influential in Washington. It's not the only bank with those. Kinds of contacts. I would stress that Citibank has a lot of graduates who now work for the Obama. Administration and are powerful on Capitol Hill. And JPMorgan Chase, which is a bank that people. Don't talk about enough, has incredible access at the level of the White House. But it is,. You're right, a small group of big Wall Street banks that are allowed to call up the Treasury. Secretary and ask him, suggest that he do this or that. If you run a small community bank in the United States and you call up your congressman and. Ask them to help you out with a regulator, they won't do it. Well, I mean, a congressman who's being very careful about the ethics rule cannot help. You. If you're Goldman Sachs and you call up the secretary of the Treasury, he's going to listen. To you very carefully and see what he can do about overall national policy. But small banks don't get that kind of opportunity. Thank you.
